args.title: checkout-api hotfix v2.3.2 shipped to all production regions

trace.final:
Done. Here's a summary:

1. **Pre-checks**: v2.3.1 was running in all regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) and was unhealthy (18% error rate). v2.3.2 had never been healthy in production, so the deploy required change-manager approval.
2. **Deploy**: Shipped v2.3.2 to all three production regions — approval was granted, rollout completed, and the service is now **healthy with a 0.2% error rate** (down from 18%).
3. **Incident**: Opened **INC-0001 (SEV3)** for checkout-api recording the hotfix deployment, its rationale, and the post-deploy health status.
